name: @muen/dsh-generate
description: The Generate space for DeepSeek Harness: one provider-neutral plugin that holds several providers, in this order everywhere — RunningHub and Comfy Cloud (workflows), Krea (image) and Magnific last (its key still to be tested) — each with its own key and its own workflows, opened as surfaces inside the one Generate pane. The provider registry, the Models-shaped settings page and the payload gate with the run are built (Krea can run; RunningHub's run is owed). The strip, the Regenerate handoff, the uploads copy and the session store ship too. Three skills ship inside it: add-rh-workflow installs a workflow, design-generate-screen decides what its screen shows.
